title: OPERA Vertical Land Motion from DISP and DISP-CAL

product.processing_facility: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory on AWS

layers.name: vertical
layers.description: Vertical displacement of the pair (up positive), absolute in IGS20 after DISP-CAL.

layers.name: vertical_std
layers.description: 1-sigma of vertical, propagated from sigma_CAL, sigma_DISP, the GNSS horizontal sigmas and the temporal resampling.

layers.name: east
layers.description: East displacement where ascending and descending overlap (mode 1); NaN elsewhere.

layers.name: mode
layers.description: 0 no data, 1 asc+desc WLS with north from GNSS, 2 single-geometry projection with east and north from GNSS (valid for long-wavelength horizontal motion only).

inputs.name: frame_id
inputs.description: Frame ID of the products to process.

inputs.name: algorithm_parameters_file
inputs.description: Path to file containing SAS algorithm parameters (YAML).

inputs.name: algorithm_parameters_overrides_json
inputs.description: JSON file of per-frame_id algorithm parameter overrides applied on top of the algorithm_parameters_file. Format: {"data": {"<frame_id>": {<option group>: {<option>: <value>}}}}.

inputs.name: ascending_disp_files
inputs.description: Ascending DISP products (DISP-S1 for VLM-S1, DISP-NISAR for VLM-NI) of the frame stack.

inputs.name: descending_disp_files
inputs.description: Descending DISP products over the same area. If absent, vertical comes from the single-geometry projection (mode 2) everywhere.

inputs.name: ascending_cal_files
inputs.description: DISP-CAL products matching each ascending DISP product (same reference/secondary dates).

inputs.name: descending_cal_files
inputs.description: DISP-CAL products matching each descending DISP product; required when descending_disp_files is given.

inputs.name: unr_grid_latlon_file
inputs.description: UNR grid lookup of the frozen snapshot. Used for GNSS east/north only when the DISP-CAL products carry no gnss_ve/gnss_vn layers; the provenance hash must then match the one in DISP-CAL.

inputs.name: unr_timeseries_dir
inputs.description: Node files of the frozen UNR snapshot (nodes/ of unr_grid_<version>_<date>); see unr_grid_latlon_file.

inputs.name: los_file_ascending
inputs.description: DISP-S1-STATIC line_of_sight_enu of the ascending frame.

inputs.name: los_file_descending
inputs.description: DISP-S1-STATIC line_of_sight_enu of the descending frame; required with descending inputs.

inputs.name: gia_model_file
inputs.description: GIA vertical-rate model (ICE-6G_D) for the context layer; omitted -> no GIA context layer.

params.name: cond_max
params.description: Above this condition number of the weighted design the WLS solve is not trusted and the pixel is projected (mode 2).

params.name: min_up
params.description: Minimum |up| component of the look vector for the single-geometry projection.

params.name: sigma_disp_meters
params.description: DISP noise below the calibration cutoff added to sigma_CAL (PRD R-E2 placeholder until TS-S1).

groups.name: temporal_options
groups.description: Resampling asc and desc onto common epochs (venti.temporal).

params.name: window_days
params.description: Full width of the moving window.

params.name: method
params.description: Robust line fit used in each window.

params.name: min_points
params.description: Fewer epochs in a window give no value.

params.name: max_extrapolation_days
params.description: Targets farther than this outside a series are not produced.

groups.name: gnss_options
groups.description: Horizontal GNSS used to fix north (and east in mode 2).

params.name: horizontal_source
params.description: cal_product: gnss_ve/gnss_vn layers of DISP-CAL; grid: sample the frozen UNR snapshot with Venti.

params.name: require_provenance_match
params.description: Fail if the GNSS provenance digest differs from the one recorded in the DISP-CAL products.

staging.name: disp
staging.description: Download DISP-S1 products for a frame and date range.

staging.name: cal
staging.description: Download the DISP-CAL products matching staged DISP products.

staging.name: unr
staging.description: Fetch a frozen UNR grid snapshot (Venti plan T48).
